subject: Comfy mask-only preflight completed; export and alignment verification underway
body:
Bounded Comfy update from the active root operator: mask-only job 16fc8010-8f8f-45ab-ad82-a8c84a11d2d9 finished in 81.90 seconds, with 0.023 compute hours reported and two galleries containing 69 frames each. Identity generation is still pending actual mask/alignment review. These are execution metrics, not an inferred credit or dollar charge.

Cloud native/media export has been unreliable. One full-resolution mask has been acquired, and root is working around the export issue through the UI to verify the remaining output. No new approval is needed and no user action is requested yet.

Current concerns are export/alignment verification and the limited Harrison Ford likeness possible while preserving the source mouth, grill, tattoos and jewelry. Billing is restored; it is not the current blocker. The single bounded sampled identity proof remains gated on passing preflight.

This is one progress/concern update on the existing task. Posted locally only; no Nova Dot reading or wakeup is established.

source.description: Root reports actual completed Cloud mask-only job metrics, gallery counts, export acquisition and outstanding review. File writer has not independently reviewed the browser or acquired media.
